Load NBA current-impact ratings

Source: R/load_models.R
load_nba_current_impact.Rd

Loads the nba_current_impact release: each NBA player's current offensive/defensive impact (points per 100 possessions) as of opening night and every 7 days after, from every game before that date – a box-score prior plus a Kalman-filtered deviation carried across seasons. Where load_nba_player_impact() says what a player did in a season, this says what to expect from him on a date. Produced by the sportsdataverse-py nba_current_impact() model (published by hoopR-nba-stats-data's nba_model_publish current-impact); player_id is the NBA Stats person_id. Coverage is 2007 (2006-07) to 2026.

Usage

load_nba_current_impact(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

Source

The nba_current_impact release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/nba_current_impact, published by https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data.

Arguments

seasons

A vector of 4-digit season-ending years (2026 = 2025-26), like load_nba_player_impact(). Published coverage runs 2007 through 2026, with no gaps; the default most_recent_nba_season() falls back to the newest published season with a message. Pass seasons = TRUE for every published season. (Min: 2007)

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the season data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the data table within the database

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per player per as-of date.

col_nametypesdescription
player_idintegerNBA Stats player identifier (person_id).
as_ofDateDate the rating is for: opening night, then every 7 days. Only games dated before it are used.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26) of the player's last game before as_of.
o_current_impactnumericExpected offensive impact per 100 possessions as of as_of: the box prior in force plus the filtered deviation from it.
d_current_impactnumericExpected defensive impact per 100 possessions as of as_of (positive = good defense).
current_impactnumericTotal expected impact per 100 possessions: o_current_impact + d_current_impact.
o_priornumericOffensive box-score prior per 100 possessions in force on as_of.
d_priornumericDefensive box-score prior per 100 possessions in force on as_of (positive = good defense).
off_possintegerOffensive possessions the player played this season before as_of (0 when he has not played this season).
def_possintegerDefensive possessions the player played this season before as_of (0 when he has not played this season).
last_game_dateDateDate of the player's last game before as_of.

See also

Other Model Dataset loader functions: load_nba_player_impact()

Author

Saiem Gilani
